text.name: Paris Agreement
text.rules: Record "pledges". LIO chooses: Stay in the agreement? If yes, LIO spends 1 point, then until the end of this turn, points spent by LIO count 1 less, never below 1; if no, SAE spends 1 point.
text.history: The Paris Agreement on climate change was adopted on 12 December 2015 and entered into force in November 2016; the United States announced its withdrawal in June 2017, rejoined in February 2021 and announced a second withdrawal in 2025.
